name_en: Kagoshima buri daikon — yellowtail and daikon simmered together, built on farmed buri
summary_ja: 養殖ブリと大根を炊き合わせた冬の定番料理。内湾でブリの稚魚モジャコがよくとれる鹿児島県はブリの養殖が盛んで、身が締まり煮崩れしにくい特産の桜島大根を合わせると味がいっそう深まるとされる。
summary_en: Farmed yellowtail and daikon simmered together, a winter standard from Japan's top producer of farmed buri. Using the prefecture's own Sakurajima daikon — dense-fleshed and slow to fall apart — is said to deepen the dish further.
source_title: ぶり大根 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理

name_en: Sangon — a three-course New Year's ritual meal of soup, sashimi, and soup, cup by cup
summary_ja: 赤椀の吸い物、刺身、黒椀の吸い物を順に食べ、間ごとに家族で焼酎を酌み交わす奄美地域の正月儀礼。室町時代の本膳料理に連なるとされ、いまも奄美では正月行事として根づいている。
summary_en: A New Year ritual from Amami: a red-lacquer soup, sashimi, then a black-lacquer soup, eaten in order with a cup of shochu passed round the family between each course. It traces to the honzen banquet style of the Muromachi period, and in Amami the custom still holds.
source_title: 三献 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理

name_en: Tonkotsu — spare ribs seared, doused in shochu, then simmered in miso and black sugar
summary_ja: 骨付きあばら肉を焼いてから芋焼酎で炒りつけ、麦味噌と黒砂糖でじっくり煮こむ鹿児島の料理。薩摩武士の野外料理が始まりと伝わり、西郷隆盛の好物でもあったという。焼酎が臭みを消し身を柔らかくする。
summary_en: Bone-in spare ribs are seared, doused with sweet-potato shochu, then slow-simmered in barley miso and black sugar. Said to have started as an outdoor dish cooked by Satsuma samurai — and a favorite of Saigo Takamori's — the shochu is said to cut any gaminess and soften the meat.
source_title: 豚骨 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理
